name: Godrej Florenne
description: Godrej Florenne is a development of 242 row houses on 20 acres off Soukya Road, about 7 km from Hope Farm Junction. The homes are designed by Hafeez Contractor with French-inspired elevations, and each rises over ground plus three levels with its own lift, courtyard, and terraces.
curation: Low density: 242 row houses across 20 acres
Every home has a pre-fitted lift, two car parks, and a private open-to-sky courtyard
A 22,000 sq.ft clubhouse over two levels
connectivity: About 15 mins to Whitefield Railway Station
About 20 mins to Hope Farm Junction
About 20 mins to HM Tech Park
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: French-inspired row houses with blue mansard roofs
